name: @sos-2/brownfield-harness
description: SOS 2.0 Brownfield Harness (Work Order W15): a runnable end-to-end harness over the golden brownfield scenario (the fake 'merch-catalog-legacy' legacy system) executing the brownfield optimization loop deterministically — BOTH worlds: the nominal world (healthy simulated experiment -> honest EXPERIMENT decision) and the degraded world (guardrail breach -> ROLLBACK decision + bounded recovery declaration + failure/rollback memory). Zero domain logic: everything is imported from @sos-2/brownfield. Prints the deterministic summary and exits 0 ONLY if both trace chains are complete. No network, no time dependence (single caller-supplied instant, fixed seed).
